place.note: local (0, 0) is the front door; the hall runs east into the hill, the wing south, as the building outside

uses.label: Look
lines: PROF. OAK's computer.
The screen is full of charts about how POKéMON grow and evolve.

uses.label: Read
lines: The shelves are crammed with research papers.
POKéMON EVOLUTION, VOL. 3... HABITATS OF KANTO... Heavy reading.

uses.label: Read
lines: LAB NOTES
Feed the tank at noon. Check the hoist chain.
New trainers arrive Monday!

uses.label: Look
lines: A big machine covered in dials and gauges.
The needles twitch. It hums like it's thinking.

uses.label: Look
lines: A huge tank of glowing liquid.
It is used to study how POKéMON react to different energies.

uses.label: Look
lines: A tall cylinder machine. The green gauge reads FULL.
It keeps the big tank's liquid at just the right temperature.

uses.label: Look
lines: Three POKé BALLS rest in the holder.
Each one holds a POKéMON PROF. OAK caught for new trainers.
Better ask the PROFESSOR before choosing one!

uses.label: Look
lines: PROF. OAK's writing desk.
A letter is half written: 'Dear Professor Elm, about the egg...'

uses.label: Sit
lines: A big orange sofa. It still smells faintly of coffee.
PROF. OAK must nap here after long nights of research.

uses.label: Look
lines: A drafting table. A half-finished blueprint is pinned to it.
It looks like plans for a new kind of POKé BALL.

uses.label: Look
lines: A tank of bubbling green liquid.
A label says: NUTRIENT MIX - DO NOT DRINK.

uses.label: Read
lines: WELCOME to the OAK POKéMON RESEARCH LAB.
Please wipe your feet, and ask before touching anything!

uses.label: Read
lines: The shelves are crammed with research papers.
POKéMON EVOLUTION, VOL. 3... HABITATS OF KANTO... Heavy reading.

uses.label: Read
lines: The shelves are crammed with research papers.

uses.label: Look
lines: A globe of the POKéMON world.
Someone circled KANTO, JOHTO and an island far to the south.

uses.label: Look
lines: A white capsule machine with a red dome.
It is for sending POKéMON safely to the lab's storage system.

uses.label: Look
lines: The computer is running the POKéDEX program.
It shows a long list of POKéMON with question marks.

uses.label: Look
lines: Brand-new POKéDEXes, ready for new trainers.
They're high-tech encyclopedias that record every POKéMON you meet.

uses.label: Read
lines: The shelves are crammed with research papers.
POKéMON EVOLUTION, VOL. 3... HABITATS OF KANTO... Heavy reading.

uses.label: Look
lines: Beakers and flasks bubble quietly on the counter.
Better not touch anything.

uses.label: Look
lines: Beakers and flasks bubble quietly on the counter.
Better not touch anything.

uses.label: Read
lines: POKéDEX PROJECT
Status: 63% of known POKéMON catalogued.
Field data is due on Friday.

uses.label: Door
lines: The door to PROF. OAK's study.
It's locked. A sign says: PRIVATE - THINKING IN PROGRESS.

actors.name: Prof. Oak
lines: OAK: Ah, there you are! Welcome to my lab.
This is where I study everything about POKéMON.
Have a look around. When you're ready, come see me by the POKé BALLS!
